about: Contract vectors computed by ikigai-core and ikigai-vocab from tests/vectors/contract_cases.json (crates/ikigai-vocab/tests/contract_vectors.rs, which fails if this file differs from what it computes). Verbs are spelled as ikigai_core::Verb serializes them; a parse that core refuses is null. A contract using no construct of the ArgSpec release is digested under `form`; one using any (groups, needs, lists, an empty enumeration, value notes, examples, an open or envelope argument set, output_from) under `form_v2`.
